Entry-screen globe (dist/intro.js), baked by scripts/bake_globe.py from NASA imagery. Background picture, not data.

Sources (downloaded 2026-10-13 from the NASA Earth Observatory pages below; kept outside the repository):

Terms (https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/, read 2026-10-13): NASA imagery is generally not
subject to copyright in the United States and may be used on web pages for educational or informational purposes;
factual use that does not imply endorsement needs no permission; NASA should be acknowledged as the source. The
NASA insignia, logotype and identifiers are protected and are not used. Credited on the entry screen ("지구 영상:
NASA Blue Marble·Black Marble") and in the app's 근거와 방법 source list.

Processing: vertical perspective of camera.json, 2x2 supersampled; D1 decoded at 10800x10800 (1 km, libjpeg DCT 1/2) within 25.0 degrees of Korea, blended 3.0 degrees into the world decoded at 10800x5400 (4 km);
worked in linear RGB: sea toned to a night blue with local contrast on the sea floor relief, land darkened to a
blue-grey with local contrast, a teal glow from the Natural Earth 200 m shelf (stronger around Korea) and a thin
shallow-water line along the coasts, Black Marble city lights added on land only (the land mask eroded 2 px, so the
fishing fleets in the East and Yellow Seas are dropped; checked: largest light over the sea = 0; 25282 land px lit above 1%), soft light from the
upper left, limb darkening and a Fresnel air band inside the rim. No outer glow (the screen draws it). sRGB WebP.
PARAMS: {"ss": 2, "d1_radius": 25.0, "d1_feather": 3.0, "lc_sigma": 0.02, "fine_sigma": 0.003, "sea_luma": 0.016, "sea_gains": [0.3, 0.8, 2.6], "shelf_gains": [0.3, 1.4, 3.0], "sea_max": 3.0, "sea_tint": [0.005, 0.018, 0.031], "sea_tint_w": 0.8, "land_luma": 0.008, "land_gains": [0.8, 1.4, 4.0], "land_max": 3.0, "land_tint": [0.011, 0.017, 0.026], "land_sat": 0.35, "land_tint_w": 0.7, "shelf_sigma": [0.006, 0.018], "shelf_color": [0.262, 0.686, 0.631], "shelf_gain": 3.2, "shelf_tint": 0.85, "shelf_amax": 0.1, "shelf_wide_w": 0.5, "shelf_on_land": 0.7, "coast_px": 2, "coast_color": [0.42, 0.8, 0.76], "coast_amax": 0.18, "korea_boost": 1.5, "lights_color": [0.89, 0.79, 0.6], "lights_gain": 1.0, "lights_gamma": 2.0, "lights_amax": 0.12, "lights_erode_px": 2, "light_dir": [-0.45, 0.55, 0.7], "shade_lo": -0.35, "shade_hi": 0.8, "shade_min": 0.3, "limb_r": 0.86, "limb_min": 0.5, "air_color": [0.275, 0.578, 0.807], "air_amax": 1.0, "air_exp": 2.5, "air_back": 0.08, "air_r0": 0.82, "exposure": 1.0, "quality": {"900": 82, "1600": 82, "2400": 80}}
